description: Top-down illustrated nightclub in the same warm, hand-painted style as the existing room art. Includes a central illuminated dance floor, DJ booth in the upper-left, and a bar on the right with a service area for an avatar behind it.
notes: Upload the regular background for a static room, or upload the spritesheet and use the animation values above.
The spritesheet repeats the same room layout across four lighting phases; only dance-floor colors and light beams shift.
Set locked tiles in the room editor wherever furniture should block avatar movement.
